subheadline: McDavid assisted on the only goal in a 1-0 win in Toronto, reaching 50 points in 21 games to start the season.

body: Connor McDavid has not been held off the scoresheet once this season. The Oilers captain set up Evan Bouchard's second-period goal in a 1-0 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Nov. 14, stretching his season-opening point streak to 21 games.
That assist gave him 50 points, with 11 goals and 39 assists, and the NHL scoring lead.
## Why fans are buying in

The company he is keeping explains the buzz. McDavid is only the fifth player in NHL history to reach 50 points in 21 games or fewer, joining Wayne Gretzky, Mario Lemieux, Bernie Nicholls and Mike Bossy. One more game with a point would tie Dany Heatley's 22-game run from 2005-06 for the fifth-longest season-opening streak in league history.

Edmonton is winning while he chases it. The Oilers are 15-3-3 after a fourth straight victory, Leon Draisaitl has points in eight straight games, and goalie Devon Levi earned his first NHL shutout in Toronto. A streak that turns every game into an event, on a team near the top of the standings, keeps the spotlight on No. 97 every night.

McDavid also has real sales history behind him. He ranked fifth on the NHL's list of top-selling jerseys for the 2025-26 regular season, based on Shop.NHL.com and Fanatics sales. In our analysis, this streak gives fans a fresh reason to add his name this season; that part is our view, not a sales figure.

McDavid is 29, already among the greatest scorers the game has seen, and he is playing at a pace the league rarely sees. body: Giannis Antetokounmpo is making Miami look like a different team. He had 34 points, 14 rebounds and eight assists as the Heat beat the Detroit Pistons 137-117 on Nov. 14, one night after he scored 37 in a win over Cleveland.
That is 71 points over two days, and it pushed the Heat to four straight wins.
## Why fans are buying in

This is still a new look for one of the league's biggest names. Miami acquired Antetokounmpo from Milwaukee in a blockbuster trade reported in June, ending 13 seasons with the Bucks that included two MVP awards and the 2021 title, when he was named Finals MVP.

The fresh start got off to a rough beginning. The Heat lost their first four games, but they have now won seven of their last nine and sit at 7-6, tied with Atlanta for first in the Southeast Division. Detroit came in leading the Central Division, which made the win a measuring stick. Klay Thompson added 26 points with six 3-pointers and Bam Adebayo scored 20, so Antetokounmpo has help around him.

Entering the game he was averaging 28.5 points and 12.3 rebounds. In our analysis, a superstar in his first season with a new team, now winning, is exactly the kind of player fans rush to wear in fresh colors. That is our view, not a sales figure.

subheadline: Diggs caught a 32-yard touchdown from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left to beat the Giants, the 80th receiving touchdown of his career.
description: Stefon Diggs caught the winning 32-yard touchdown with 57 seconds left as Washington beat the Giants 24-21 on Nov. 12. Why his Commanders jersey is rising now.
searchIntent: Commanders and NFL fans who saw Diggs's late touchdown against the Giants want to know what it means for Washington and which Diggs jersey to get.
body: Stefon Diggs delivered when Washington needed it most. With 57 seconds left on Thursday night, he caught a 32-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels to give the Commanders a 24-21 win over the New York Giants on Nov. 12.
He finished with six catches for 83 yards, and the score was the 80th receiving touchdown of his career. Only 29 players in NFL history had reached that mark before him.
## Why fans are buying in

Diggs is in his first season in Washington, and this was the kind of play that makes a new receiver a fan favorite fast. He caught a touchdown in his Commanders debut in Week 1, but a game-winner in a division road game carries more weight than any opener.

It also kept the NFC East race alive. Washington improved to 3-5-1 and sits two games behind the division-leading Giants at 5-3-1, but the Commanders now hold the tiebreaker after the teams tied earlier this season. Rasul Douglas sealed the win with an interception in the final 25 seconds.

The connection with Daniels is the bigger story for fans. Daniels threw for 249 yards and three touchdowns, and he now has a proven veteran who can win a tight game late. In our analysis, a moment like this gives Commanders fans a new name to pair with their quarterback. That is our view, not a sales figure.
